mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_favorite (user_id, goods_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goodsId}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goods_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.price, s.category, s.images, s.condition, s.status, s.seller_id, s.view_count, s.create_time, u.username as seller_name FROM goods_favorite f INNER JOIN secondhand s ON f.goods_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user u ON s.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'APPROVED' AND (s.deleted = 0 OR s.deleted IS NULL) ORDER BY f.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods_favorite f INNER JOIN secondhand s ON f.goods_id = s.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'APPROVED' AND (s.deleted = 0 OR s.deleted IS NULL)
